chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from 'Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sayf ibn 'Umayrah, from Abi Bakr, who said:
I asked Aba Ja'far عليه السلام, “What should I do when I become junub?” He said: “Wash your hands and your private part, perform wudu (ablution) like the wudu of salat (prayer), then perform ghusl.”

key_terms.أَجْنَبْتُ: I entered the state of janabah, requiring ritual purification
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), referenced to define the form of wudu
key_terms.فَرْجَكَ: your private part, to be washed as part of purification
key_terms.كَفَّيْكَ: your two hands, to be washed first
key_terms.وُضُوءَ: wudu (ablution), performed in the manner of salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What should a person do after becoming junub according to Imam Aba Ja'far عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the procedure to follow after janabah. Imam Aba Ja'far عليه السلام instructs washing the hands and private part, then performing wudu (ablution) like that of salat (prayer), and afterward performing ghusl.
